design_baseline: Existing 2L PET prototype v2; unmeasured values explicitly labeled

visual_review.scope: Both eight-frame timed contact sheets, posters and selected full-resolution rendered frames
checks: Original three-fin CAD geometry and exploded translations are recognizable
Design title, numerical panels and assumptions are readable in selected frames
Extended terrain and camera clipping remove the earlier finite-ground band
No flame or smoke is used for water/air propulsion
Liquid visibility and displayed state are checked against the numerical timeline
limitations: Approximate bottle, launcher, trees and ground remain visibly CG
Ballistic water parcels do not resolve real breakup, splash or air drag
Empty PET can retain a blue tint from refraction; it does not indicate remaining water
Real-time full playback and actual audio listening were not performed

audio_review: Stereo WAV signal level and duration checks; original synthetic cues and flow-driven noise, not measured acoustics
physics_scope: Conditional still-air vertical ascent to apogee; no attitude, retention, structure or recovery qualification
production_method: AI-assisted scene scripting, exact frozen STL, numerical integration and local physically based rendering; no service watermark
